messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: us-east-1 streaming p99 latency jumped to ~2.1s at 2026-03-15T09:55Z. p95 also elevated. Prefetch miss rate and paging counters spiked.
ops-alice: seeing the same on grafana, p99 jump lines up with a deployment around 09:55. cache hit % tanked on several prefix shards.
oncall-ben: I'm taking this incident. paging oncall. which deploy rolled?
engineer-lina: It was the prefix-hash v3 rollout (canary -> partial). v3 changes salt/length. Early signs: large cache invalidations and a flood of KV misses.
eng-sre-sam: Quick mitigation list: pause rollout, enable traffic fallback to stable model, spin up extra cache capacity, kick off warmup for hot prefixes, increase prefetch parallelism.
oncall-ben: Lina, pause the rollout and confirm. I'll handle routing.
engineer-lina: Paused at 2026-03-15T09:58:05Z (`kubectl annotate deployment/prefix-hash rollout-paused=true`) — canary stopped.
incident-bot: ACTION recorded: rollout paused by engineer-lina at 2026-03-15T09:58:05Z.
oncall-ben: routing change: diverting 30% traffic to stable-variant via `route:stable-fallback-20260315`. Applying now.
ops-alice: routing applied. p99 moving down slowly 2.1s -> ~1.5s. cache hit-rate creeping back up on some hosts from ~45% -> ~62%.
eng-sre-sam: Launching targeted warmup for top-10 hot prefixes and bumping prefetch worker count. Also increasing cache node pool by +25% while we stabilize.
engineer-lina: Root suspicion: v3 salt mapping remapped many keys to new buckets (namespace split). We didn't prepopulate new buckets so hot keys missed causing synchronous backfills and heavy paging.
customer-success-raj: CS: two customers flagged as experiencing intermittent stream stalls. Preparing an interim customer note.
oncall-ben: Impact snapshot: region us-east-1 only so far. p99 SLO (target <800ms) breached for roughly 10–15 minutes. Estimated affected sessions ~8k. No revenue-critical escalations yet.
ops-alice: kernel/paging metrics show increased pageins and GC pressure on several cache nodes. Eviction rate spiked right after the v3 traffic increase.
eng-sre-sam: Mitigations summary: rollout paused, routing fallback in place, scaled caches, warmup running, prefetch more aggressive. Monitoring for p99 < 800ms.
engineer-lina: We're preparing a safe rollforward plan which includes: parity fix for salt, prepopulate migration, and a stricter canary gating (require hit-rate >= 85% for 15m before wider rollout). Not rolling forward until those checks pass.
oncall-ben: Handoff plan: I'll watch for 30m, then hand to infra rotation at 11:00Z. Tasks for handoff: validate no new canaries, monitor p95/p99, verify streaming stalls cleared, check per-shard hit-rate, coordinate with CS.
infra-miguel: I'll take over at 11:00Z. What else needs to be left active?
oncall-ben: Keep warmup jobs running, keep routing fallback enabled, keep autoscaling margins. Contact me immediately on regressions or new deploys.
customer-success-raj: Draft customer message (ready to send): "We observed elevated latency affecting streaming in us-east-1 between ~09:55–10:06 UTC. Mitigations (pause, routing fallback, cache warmup) are in place. We will follow with a full RCA and remediation timeline." Will send after no objections.
eng-sre-sam: Can Lina upload the prefix mapping diff and top miss keys to the incident doc? Need list for analysis.
engineer-lina: Pasting sample mapping diff and uploaded full CSV to the doc:
```
# mapping diff sample
old: prefix_ab12 -> shard-03
v3:  prefix_ab12 -> shard-17
# top misses: prefix_ab12, prefix_cf00, prefix_ff99, prefix_0012 ...
```
Uploaded top-50 miss keys to incident doc at 10:15Z.
infra-miguel: 10:25 status update: p99 ~760ms, p95 ~330ms, cluster hit-rate ~84%. No new customer escalations. Keeping warmup active.
oncall-ben: Handing off to infra-miguel now. My watch ends 10:30Z. Ben -> Miguel.
incident-bot: HANDOFF: oncall-ben handed off to infra-miguel at 2026-03-15T10:30:00Z.
infra-miguel: Took over monitoring at 10:30Z. Suppressing noisy alerts for mitigations. Will watch for sustained p99 < 800ms for 20m before clearing.
eng-sre-sam: Postmortem checklist: timeline, root cause (prefixhash v3 remap + no prepopulate), mitigation steps, action items (add pre-rollout warmup to checklist, enforce canary hit-rate gate, add synthetic smoke for hit-rate), owners.
engineer-lina: I'll draft the postmortem including code diffs and the updated rollout checklist. Target: initial draft by EOD.
customer-success-raj: I'll coordinate detailed customer communications once postmortem is ready. Interim note posted at 10:12Z.
infra-miguel: Monitoring watch until 10:55Z unless regressions. Current metrics stable.
oncall-ben: Closing active paging watch at 10:30Z. Thanks all. :thumbsup: 
ops-alice: I'll add a short runbook entry for prefix-hash rollouts requiring a warmup phase and a pre-rollout smoke test.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: metrics returned to SLO at 10:52Z. Severity lowered; postmortem requested.
